$comment: Machine-readable dependency manifest for SuperCitycon / MiniMax Game Studio ULTRA V2. Generated 2026-11-08 from the working tree. Every version here is pinned and reproducible; nothing is a floating range at install time.

node.notes: The CI workflow pins Node 20. The local machine that produced this handover ran Node 22.14.0 and passed every check.

python.usedFor: the 3D design gates under minimax-game/tools (verify_design.py, verify_devbots.py, audit_depth.py, build_master.py, fault_inject_hardened.py). Standard library only — no pip install is needed.

vite.role: the build tool and dev server

esbuild.platformNote: ships prebuilt binaries per platform as OPTIONAL dependencies: darwin-x64, darwin-arm64, linux-x64, linux-arm64, win32-x64 and others are all in package-lock.json. npm installs the one matching the host.

rollup.platformNote: same optional per-platform binary scheme as esbuild; darwin-arm64 and darwin-x64 are both in the lockfile.

fsevents.role: macOS file-watching for the dev server
fsevents.platformNote: darwin only, optional; the dev server still works without it, just without instant file-change reload.

playwright.declared: NOT a package.json dependency — installed out of tree, see portability notes
playwright.role: drives the headless Chromium that runs the 41-check acceptance harness
playwright.resolvedFrom: tools/playwright-resolve.mjs, which tries PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE, then a normal install, then known local locations

3d.source: the user's own asset library; five packs
3d.counts: 158 assets: 41 KayKit City Builder Bits, 41 Avramania Nature & Terrain, 46 Holokat Game Assets, 6 KayKit Adventurers, 14 Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character, 8 Quaternius Ultimate Animated Animals, 2 KayKit Skeletons

2d.note: Excluded from the publishable build by npm run build:cleared. The local build includes them and writes dist/DO-NOT-PUBLISH.txt.

audio.notes: The library holds no audio, so the game uses a small procedural WebAudio synth (src/audio/audio.js) — oscillators and noise buffers, no samples. Nothing to license.

verificationCommands.designGates: cd minimax-game && python3 tools/verify_design.py && python3 tools/audit_depth.py && python3 tools/verify_devbots.py && python3 tools/fault_inject_hardened.py
